newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ ups 5 food cos, cuts Campbell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ ups 5 food cos, cuts Campbell.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin Jenrette analyst William Leach confirmed that he upgraded his rating of five food companies and cut Campbell Soup Co to underperform from a market perform rating.
-- said new price targets based on 1998 earnings estimates.
-- said Campbell downgrade based on strong stock price and disappointing soup sales.
-- Archer Daniels Midland Co was upgraded to a buy from a market perform rating.
-- Universal Foods Corp was upgraded to a buy from a market perform rating.
-- Sara Lee Corp was upgraded to a buy from a market perform rating.
-- Quaker Oats Co was upgraded to a market perform from an underperform rating.
-- General Mills Inc was upgraded to a market perform from an underperfomr rating.
-- Estimate for Archer Daniel June 1997 fiscal year is $1.30 a share, 1998 estimate is $1.35 a share.
-- Estimate for Universal Foods June 1997 fiscal year is $2.50 a share, 1998 estimate is $2.70 a share.
-- Estimate for Sara Lee July 1997 fiscal year is $2.05 a share, 1998 estimate is $2.30 a share.
-- Estimate for Quaker Oats 1997 fiscal (calendar) year is $1.40 a share, 1998 estimate is $1.60 a share.
-- Estimate for General Mills May 1997 fiscal year is $3.08 a share, 1998 estimate is $3.45 a share.
-- Estimate for Campbell Soup July 1997 fiscal year is $3.65 a share, 1998 estimate is $4.20 a share.
